The web search backend returned no result, so I’m using the dedicated Wikipedia search for the source pages and will then verify the arithmetic independently.
```python
wikipedia_lookup = await wikipedia_search("Moon", max_results=5)
print(wikipedia_lookup)
``` 

I’m also checking Kipchoge’s Wikipedia entry directly; the calculation depends on his marathon time rather than a generic running speed.
```python
kipchoge_lookup = await wikipedia_search("Eliud Kipchoge", max_results=5)
print(kipchoge_lookup)
``` 

I’m fetching the two Wikipedia pages directly, which avoids the failed search index and provides the page text needed for the requested values.
```python
moon_page = await web_fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moon", max_chars=12000)
print(moon_page)
``` 

17000 hours
